notes: Each case names an operation (covers: section 5; supported: section 6), a fixed clock, inputs and expected assertions.
The clock supplies the evaluation time when asOf is absent; an explicit asOf remains distinguishable from an omitted one.
Expected fields are assertions, not complete results: status always, resolvedRanges where the case pins them.
policyResources maps a support definition url to the decoded JSON found there; a url with no entry is unavailable.
cle is the list of CLE pages, supplied in full; cleComplete is the caller's statement that no page is missing.
All cases use the npm, semver and pypi profiles of Annex A. Cases for other profiles will follow their review.
